alt: A ribbon stream runs along even rows of faceted paper plants.
prompt: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, nearly square (about 1:1), safe to crop to 4:5 around the centre. A calm field seen from slightly above, laid out in long, perfectly even rows of small flat faceted paper plants in Partner Navy, slate blue and pale blue, like the lines of a tidy ledger. A smooth satin ribbon stream in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan flows in from the upper left and runs along the head of the field, feeding every row in turn: books kept in order without the typing. Generous calm Daylight space in the top third. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
